evals.prompt: Make my app's landing page in Figma Make.
evals.expected_output: No brief exists; the skill does not send a thin prompt to the tool: it runs design-brief first (which routes to design-system or mkt-messaging when the foundation or copy is missing) and only then plans the runs; the reply is in English.
assertions: No run pack is written before a brief exists
The reply names design-brief as the first step
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt

evals.prompt: Run docs/design/briefs/og-image.md as a code prototype.
evals.expected_output: docs/design/results/og-image.md with one run per direction, a prompt pack and HTML plus PNG outputs per run rendered with scripts/screenshot.mjs at 1200 × 630, a verdict with evidence for every CRIT of the brief per run, a recommendation and a pending decision; lint_result.py ok; no confirmation asked, because a local prototype writes to no external account.
assertions: Every run has prompt.md, HTML and PNG files under docs/design/results/og-image/round-1/
Every CRIT of the brief has a pass, partial or fail verdict with evidence for every run
The decision is recorded as pending, not taken by the agent
No confirmation gate is shown for the local prototype

evals.prompt: Run the documentation page brief in Claude Design.
evals.expected_output: Assisted mode, because the tool offers no generation interface to agents: one run pack per direction with the direction filled into the prompt and the attachments listed, a results document with every run 'waiting on user', status 'waiting on user', and instructions to the user on what to bring back; the agent stops instead of claiming results.
assertions: The mode is assisted and the reason is stated
There is one prompt pack per direction
Every run is marked waiting on user and the document status matches
The agent does not invent or describe results it has not seen
